purpose: Pinned pool for per-run rotation of the UNTIMED MTP correctness gate. One member is drawn deterministically per ranked run (seed = GITHUB_RUN_ID + GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, index = seed % eligible member count) by .github/scripts/select-mtp-gate-rotation.sh, downloaded from R2, pin-verified, and run as an additional fail-closed exact-token leg. The TIMED benchmark golden never rotates: rotating it would force baseline recalibration. Members whose sha256/bytes pins are empty are not yet operator-provisioned and are skipped by the selector; fill r2_key, sha256, and bytes after freezing each golden on the ranked M5 box (see docs/mtp-track-golive-runbook.md).
